question: What is the weirdest thing a roommate ever hid from you?
story: My roommate moved out in March, and I did not find out he was still living in our apartment until July. His name was Trevor. He gave notice, packed a van, hugged me at the door, and left. I found a new roommate. Life went on. But food kept disappearing. Never a lot. A yogurt. Half a rotisserie chicken. The good coffee. I quietly blamed the new guy for four months. Then I came home early on a Tuesday and heard a cough from the storage closet off our balcony, the one the landlord swore was unusable. Trevor had a camping mattress in there. A lamp. A power strip. A little shelf of paperbacks. He had never actually left. He had just stopped paying rent. Here is the worst part. When I opened that door, he did not panic. He looked up from his book and said, hey man, do you mind.
